control._why: Surrak can't be countered and draws when targeted; Sapling Nursery keeps making 3/4s through removal and wipes. Cuts creature removal and the weakest card-flow spell.

midrange._why: Surrak is a strong 3-drop vs removal; Sheltered by Ghosts and Erode answer their best threat.

aggro._why: Clarion Conqueror blocks fliers; Erode and Seam Rip kill early threats. Cuts the slow card-flow spells.
